name: SP500 Monday IBS < 0.5 below Friday close, 5-day hold
author: hobbiecode
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: On Monday: close < previous Friday close AND IBS = (close-low)/(high-low) < 0.5; enter long at the close.
exit: Exit at the close when close > previous day high, or after 5 trading days (4 bars since entry), whichever first.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Calendar + IBS combination; one position at a time.
